title: Do crunches burn belly fat? 🔥
caption:
Spot reduction is a myth: in studies, training one area did not burn the fat on top of it. Your body picks where fat comes off. Lose fat overall and the abs show. Did you believe this one? 👇

Gym Myths Busted #1
first_comment: How many crunches did you do hoping for abs? Be honest 😅
sources: Vispute SS et al. The effect of abdominal exercise on abdominal fat. J Strength Cond Res 2011;25:2559-2564
Ramírez-Campillo R et al. Regional fat changes induced by localized muscle endurance resistance training. J Strength Cond Res 2013;27:2219-2224
